# The OCD & Anxiety Center

> Specialized mental health clinic providing evidence-based therapy for OCD, anxiety disorders, and related conditions across multiple locations in Illinois and Georgia.

The OCD & Anxiety Center operates therapy clinics in Oak Brook, Orland Park, and Barrington, Illinois, as well as Marietta, Georgia. The center specializes in treating anxiety disorders, OCD, childhood anxiety, autism-related anxiety, and trauma using evidence-based approaches including exposure therapy and cognitive-behavioral techniques.

## Key Topics

- OCD (Obsessive-Compulsive Disorder)
- Anxiety Disorders
- Panic Disorder
- Social Anxiety
- Health Anxiety
- Selective Mutism
- Separation Anxiety
- School Phobia
- Childhood Anxiety
- Teen/Adolescent Therapy
- Autism and Anxiety
- Exposure Therapy
- Evidence-Based Treatment
- Oak Brook, IL
- Orland Park, IL
- Marietta, GA
